title: Saray Managpaalagey na Tore
intro: Diad abayag lan panaon, sakey a mabiskeg a sibilisasyon so inmalagey, a nibiig ed makapadinayew iran gawa na panagpaalagey tan makapataktakot a biskeg to. Sayan pankakasakey so naikdan na daakan iran kayamanan tan pisikal a biskeg, balet ta pinili ra so dalan na panagsumlang ed madibinon mensahe ya imbaki pian mangigiya ed sikara. Say istorya ra et sakey a baleg a leksion ed saray awaran na awaran, sakey a paneknek ed saray pansumpalan na pangipulisay ed katuaan.
clues: Naikdan kami na baleg a biskeg tan katagey, aliwan singa arum a totoo ed panaon mi.
Kabkabat kamin mangipapaalagey na angkakabaleg iran istruktura tan atagey iran lusek ed amin ya atagey a pasen, ya iisipen min manbilay kamin andi-anggaan.
Sakey a mensahero a nanlapud limog mi so imbaki pian pasakbayan kami, ya tawagen to kamin mandayew ed si Allah labat tan taynanan iray talintao mi.
Mapaatagey min tinepetan so mensahero mi, ya tinepetan mi no kasin linma rad sikami pian mandayew kami labat ed si Allah tan taynanan so dadayewen na inmuunan atateng mi.
Say dalin mi et abendisyonan na saray hardin, subol, tan mabunan uma, balet ta impasen min say inkaaligwas mi et lapud pakayari mi, aliwan lapud Manamalsa mi.
Lapud pirmin agmi panisia tan panagludlurey mi, diad kaunoran et apatey kami na makapataktakot tan masebeg a dagem ya inmawet ed loob na dakel ya agew tan labi.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say pangibagat ed sakey ya espisipikon kamelyo
Say angat ya manggawa na samploran surah a singa say Quran
Say pakapasakbay na sakey a propeta nipaakar ed onsasabin delap
Say pangipulisay ed sakey a propeta ya amasakbay sumpad alablabas a panagpaalagey tan panagdayew ed saray idolo
trial.answer: Say pangipulisay ed sakey a propeta ya amasakbay sumpad alablabas a panagpaalagey tan panagdayew ed saray idolo

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Saray atagey a lusek tan malet iran ayaman
location.answer: Saray atagey a lusek tan malet iran ayaman

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nauman ed saray unggoy tan baboy
Dineral na maksil ya insabog na karol
Naderal na masebeg tan makapasinagem a dagem
outcome.answer: Naderal na masebeg tan makapasinagem a dagem

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
